title: mesh.tet.generate rejects a SolidCraft body with "open edge" along a 1e-5 mm seam that a SolidCraft boolean retry left; it meshes with `weld: 1e-5`
body:
### Observed failure A SolidCraft body made by an intersect that fell back to SolidCraft's tool nudge ("Boolean retry: tool displacement 1.026462e-4 mm, rotation 2.000000e-6 rad") will not tet-mesh with the default options: ``` error: step 2 (mesh.tet.generate): invalid boundary surface: 3 defects; open edge 2–13 at (6.11988e-5, -24.5, 9.99999) mm (only triangle 4 uses it); open edge 2–26 at (7.34372e-5, -12.0001, 9.99999) mm (only triangle 10 uses it); open edge 13–26 at (7.29477e-5, -12.5, 10) mm (only triangle 8 uses it) ``` The defects lie on the top face. That face comes from two coplanar faces at z = 10, the disc's and the box's. The nudge left one of them about 1e-5 mm lower (z = 9.99999), so the top is two pieces that meet along a seam whose sides are 1e-5 mm apart. SolidCraft reports the body as fine: one shell, no error. Its own STL export of the same body is closed: every edge has exactly one opposite twin. With `"weld": 1e-5` (or `"weld_distance": 0.001`) the same body meshes: 7 153 tet4. ### Reproduction Files (primitives only): - `intersect.json`: a Ø50 × 10 mm disc with a 1 mm bottom chamfer, intersected with a 30 × 30 × 10 mm box from z = 0. - `mesh_intersect.json` and `mesh_intersect_weld.json` (both below). 1. `solidcraft-cli run intersect.json --save intersect.solidcraft` (SolidCraft 0.18.2). The Box1 feature warns "Boolean retry: tool displacement 1.026462e-4 mm, rotation 2.000000e-6 rad". 2. `fieldcraft-cli run mesh_intersect.json`: ```json [{"command": "geometry.open", "params": {"path": "intersect.solidcraft"}}, {"command": "mesh.tet.generate", "params": {"body": "Disc", "tolerance": 0.01}}] ``` The result is the error above. 3. `fieldcraft-cli run mesh_intersect_weld.json` (the same with `"weld": 1e-5`): 7 153 tet4. ### Evidence | Script | Result | |---|---| | `mesh_intersect.json` (default weld) | invalid boundary surface: 3 defects, open edges at z = 9.99999 / 10 | | `mesh_intersect_weld.json` (`weld: 1e-5`) | 7 153 tet4 | | the same with `weld: 1e-3` or `weld_distance: 0.001` | 7 153 tet4 | ### Expected behaviour SolidCraft's boolean retries move faces by up to about 1e-4 mm. A body that SolidCraft builds without error, and exports closed, should either: - mesh with the default options, with the default weld covering that displacement (the documented default is "twice SolidCraft's linear tolerance for a tessellated body"); or - fail with a message that names the fix, for example "open edges along a seam 1e-5 mm wide: try weld_distance ≥ 2e-5". Today the message only lists the defects. `weld` is documented under `mesh.surface.check`, so the fix is hard to find from the error. ### Investigation - The seam comes from SolidCraft's tool nudge: the tool is turned 2e-6 rad and moved 2e-6 of the size, and the result keeps that. Faces that should be coplanar end up 1e-5 to 1e-4 mm apart. In the original (private) model, the bottom face came out in pieces at z = 0 and z = 5.5e-6, with 81 open edges along the seam. - Related: #384 (sliver faces from a coincident partition give open edges, closed) and #507 (`geometry.stitch` for imported surfaces). - A second case, `join.json` / `mesh_join.json`: the same disc with a 20 × 12 × 4 mm box joined from z = 0, also nudged. It fails with 30 "oriented inconsistently" defects near z = 4.6e-5 to 9e-5, and `weld` does not help. SolidCraft's own STL export of that body already has 21 edges used twice in the same direction, so that case is a SolidCraft tessellation defect (the family of tangency-labs/solidcraft#2356), not FieldCraft's. It is included for completeness: `mesh_join.json`, `mesh_join_weld.json`. ### Version and platform - FieldCraft develop 8b1a01e (fieldcraft-cli 0.7.0, built from source), Linux x86_64. - The designs were saved by SolidCraft 0.18.2 on Windows 11.
intersect.json and mesh_intersect_weld.json ```json [ {"command": "solid.cylinder", "params": {"diameter": 50, "height": 10, "body_name": "Disc"}}, {"command": "solid.chamfer", "params": {"edges": [[25, 0, 0]], "distance": 1}}, {"command": "solid.box", "params": {"length": 30, "width": 30, "height": 10, "corner": [0, -30, 0], "operation": "intersect", "targets": ["Disc"]}} ] ``` ```json [ {"command": "geometry.open", "params": {"path": "intersect.solidcraft"}}, {"command": "mesh.tet.generate", "params": {"body": "Disc", "tolerance": 0.01, "weld": 1e-05}} ] ```
